name: MA Simcoe Step Study
notes: Working from the Big Book Sponsorship workbook, designed to help those who want to start working the Steps with others, and from Life with Hope, the book of Marijuana Anonymous. All addicts are welcome. Online and by phone.

name: Rainbow Recovery
notes: A safe space exclusively serving the 2SLGBTQIA+ community and questioning people in Toronto. A closed meeting, except the third meeting of every month, which is open.
location_notes:
Entrance: off the parking lot. Use the intercom to reach the front desk, who will let you in.
Room: the Board Room on the main floor — head right down the hall, last door on your right.
formatted_address: 650 Church St, Toronto, ON M4Y 2G5, Canada

name: Women, Non-Binary, and Beyond
notes: Anyone who identifies as a woman, non-binary, TGNC (transgender and gender non-conforming), and/or gender-expansive is welcome to be a member of this group. For all those who have a desire to stop using marijuana, regardless of race, creed, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, or any other trait. A closed meeting. The speaker meeting is on the fourth Thursday of every month.
